violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. Debris buildup was discovered behind the lid of the sandwich cold hold/prep table. Detail clean around lid more frequently.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Surface of equipment/utensil did not reach minimum temperature of 160F during hot water sanitize rinse of warewash machine. Warewash machine surface temperatures of equipment did not meet the 160F sanitizing temperature requirement. Ensure the warewash machine meets the 160F requirement for sanitizing using hot water.
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Backflow prevention, back siphonage (3 pts deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
